questions.q: Number of points from where perpendicular tangents to the curve <math><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mrow><mn>16</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>-</mo><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mrow><mn>25</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></math> can be drawn, is/are
questions.solution: Director circle is the set of points from where drawn tangents are perpendicular, in this case <math><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>-</mo><msup><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></math> (equation of director circle) <math><mi>i.</mi><mi>e.</mi><mo>,</mo><mi> </mi><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>9</mn></math> is not a real circle, so there is no point from where perpendicular tangents can be drawn.

questions.q: Tangents are drawn from the point <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">α</mi><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">β</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> to the hyperbola <math><mn>3</mn><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>6</mn></math> and are inclined at angles <math><mi mathvariant="normal">θ</mi></math> and <math><mi mathvariant="normal">ϕ</mi></math> to the <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></math>-axis. If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mrow><mi>tan</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">θ</mi></mrow></mfenced><mfenced><mrow><mi>tan</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">ϕ</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></math>, then the value of <math><mn>2</mn><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">α</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>-</mo><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">β</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></math> is
questions.solution:
Given hyperbola is 3x2-2y2=6 or x22-y23=1
Slope form of tangent is y=mx±a2m2-b2or y-mx2=a2m2-b2

Tangent from the point α, β is given by,

β-mα2=2m2-3
⇒m2α2-2-2αβm+β2+3=0
m1m2=β2+3α2-2=2=tan⁡θtan⁡ϕ
∴β2+3=2α2-4⇒7=2α2-β2

questions.solution:
∵P lies on director circle x2+y2=a2-b2
∴ a2-b2=7 …(i)
Also, 2ae=10⇒ae=5 …(ii)
Now, e2=a2+b2a2⇒a2+b2=25 …(iii)
From (i) & (iii), we get,
 a2=16,b2=9

questions.q: Let <math><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><msup><mrow><mi>r</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></math> and <math><mi>x</mi><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></math> intersects at <math><mi>A</mi></math> and <math><mi>B</mi></math> in first quadrant. If <math><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mo>=</mo><msqrt><mn>14</mn></msqrt></math> units, then the value of <math><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mrow><mi>r</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> is
questions.solution:
Let A=t,1t & B=1t,t ∵Both curves are symmetric about line y=x
then, AB2=t-1t2+1t-t2=14
⇒2t2+1t2=14+4⇒t2+1t2=9
Now, OA2=t2+1t2=9⇒2r2=9
⇒2r=3 ⇒r=1.5

questions.q: If two points <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>P</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Q</mi></math> lie on the hyperbola <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><msup><mi>a</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mfrac><mo>-</mo><mfrac><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><msup><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo> </mo><mo>(</mo><mi>a</mi><mo><</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>)</mo></math>, whose centre <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>C</mi></math> be such that <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>C</mi><mi>P</mi></math> is perpendicular to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>C</mi><mi>Q</mi></math>, then the value of <math><mfrac><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mi>C</mi><msup><mrow><mi>P</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mi>C</mi><msup><mrow><mi>Q</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfrac></math> is
questions.solution:
Let CP=r1 be inclined to transverse axis at an angle θ such that Pr1cos⁡θ, r1sin⁡θ lies on the hyperbola. Therefore,

r12 cos2⁡θa2-sin2⁡θb2=1

Replacing θ by 90o+θ, we get, 

r22 sin2⁡θa2-cos2⁡θb2=1

(where, CQ=r2)

⇒  1r12+1r22=cos2⁡θa2 -sin2⁡θb2+sin2⁡θa2-cos2⁡θb2

⇒  1r12+1r22=cos2⁡θ1a2-1b2+sin2⁡θ1a2-1b2

⇒  1r12+1r22=1a2-1b2

⇒  1CP2+1CQ2=1a2-1b2

questions.q: If a circle drawn by assuming a chord parallel to the transverse axis of hyperbola <math><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfrac><mo>-</mo><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></math> as diameter always passes through <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>2,0</mn></mrow></mfenced></math>, then
questions.solution:
Let, the end points of the diameter of circle are asec⁡θ,btan⁡θ & -asec⁡θ,btan⁡θ
⇒ Equation of circle is x-asec⁡θx+asec⁡θ+y-btan⁡θ2=0
⇒x2-a2sec2⁡θ+y2+b2tan2⁡θ-2btan⁡θy=0
Because 2,0 satisfies above equation,
hence, 4-a21+tan2⁡θ+0+b2tan2⁡θ=0
⇒4-a2+b2-a2tan2⁡θ=0
Which is always true if a=2 & b=2

questions.q: If the focus of a hyperbola is <math><mo>(</mo><mo>±</mo><mn>3,0</mn><mo>)</mo></math> and the equation of a tangent is <math><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>, then the equation of the hyperbola is
questions.solution:
Given, ±ae, 0=±3, 0

⇒  ae=3

⇒ a2e2=9 

⇒ b2+a2=9 ...(i)

∵ 2x+y-4=0

⇒   y=-2x+4

is the tangent to the hyperbola

∴  42=a2-22-b2 ∵c2=a2m2-b2

⇒  4a2-b2=16 ...(ii)

On solving Eqs. (i) and (ii), we get,

a2=5, b2=4 

∴ Equation of hyperbola is x25–y24 =1

⇒ 4x2-5y2=20

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: From a point <math><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi><mo>,</mo></math> two tangents <math><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></math> and <math><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></math> are drawn to the hyperbola <math><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfrac><mo>-</mo><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>.</mo></math> If these tangents cut the coordinate axes at <math><mn>4</mn></math> concyclic points, then the locus of <math><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></math> is
questions.solution:
Let the equation of tangents are
y=m1x+C1, and
y=m2x+C2
which cuts the coordinate axes at E,F,G,H as shown in the figure
Now, OE×OG=OF×OH
⇒-C1m1×+C2m2=C1-C2⇒m1m2=1
Let P be h,k and equation of the tangent through P on the hyperbola is
y=mx±a2m2-b2
⇒k2-mh2=a2m2-b2
⇒h2-a2m2-2khm+k2+b2=0
whose roots are m1 and m2⇒m1m2=k2+b2h2-a2=1
⇒ locus is x2-y2=a2+b2

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: For the hyperbola <math><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mrow><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfrac><mo>-</mo><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mrow><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo></math> distance between the foci is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>10</mn></math> units. From the point <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt></mrow></mfenced><mo>,</mo></math> perpendicular tangents are drawn to the hyperbola, then the value of <math><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mfenced></math> is
questions.solution:
Let, e be the eccentricity of the hyperbola
Now, 2ae=10⇒a2e2=25
⇒a2+b2=25
Also 2,3 lies on the director circle x2+y2=a2-b2
⇒7=a2-b2⇒a2=16, b2=9
⇒ba=34=0.75

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: A tangent drawn to the hyperbola <math><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfrac><mo>-</mo><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></math> at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>P</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>a</mi><mi>sec</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>6</mn></mfrac><mo>,</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>tan</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>6</mn></mfrac></mrow></mfenced></math> form a triangle of area <math><mn>3</mn><msup><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></math> sq. units with the coordinate axes. The eccentricity of the conjugate hyperbola of <math><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfrac><mo>-</mo><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></math> is
questions.solution:
P=2a3,b3
Equation of the tangent at P is 2x3a-y3b=1
x intercept & y intercept of the tangent are 3a2 & -3b respectively
Area of the triangle formed by the tangent with the coordinate axes is 
12×3a2×3b=3a2
⇒ba=4⇒ab=14
The eccentricity of the conjugate hyperbola equals to
1+116=174

questions.q: The locus of the mid-point of the chords of the hyperbola <math><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>-</mo><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo></math> that touches the parabola <math><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>x</mi></math> is
questions.solution:
Let midpoint of the chord be Ph,k.

Then, the equation of the chord will be xh-yk=h2-k2
⇒y=hkx+k2-h2k … 1
Now, the line y=mx+c is tangent to y2=4ax if c=am
Hence, equation 1 is tangent to y2=8x if
k2-h2k=2kh⇒y2x-x3=2y2
⇒y2x-2=x3

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: The locus of the mid-points of the chords of the hyperbola <math><mn>3</mn><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> which are parallel to the line <math><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn></math> is
questions.solution:
Let mid-point of the chord is h,k
⇒ equation of the chord is
3hx-2ky+4x+h2-6y+k2=3h2-2k2+4h-6k
⇒3h+2x+-2k-3y=3h2-2k2+2h-3k
⇒ Slope of the chord is equal to 3h+22k+3=2
⇒ locus of the mid-points is 3x+2=4y+6
⇒3x-4y-4=0

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: The chords passing through <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>2,1</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> intersect the hyperbola <math><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mrow><mn>16</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>-</mo><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mrow><mn>9</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></math> at <math><mi>A</mi></math> and <math><mi>B</mi><mo>.</mo></math> The locus of the point of intersection of tangents at <math><mi>A</mi></math> and <math><mi>B</mi></math> on the hyperbola is
questions.solution:
Let, the point of intersection of the tangents at A & B is h,k.
Then, the equation of AB is xh16-yk9=1 { ∵T=0 is the chord of contact}
Now, xh16-yk9=1 passes through 2,1
Hence, 2h16-k9=1
⇒9h-8k=72
⇒ the locus is 9x-8y=72

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: Two straight lines having variable slopes <math><msub><mrow><mi>m</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> and <math><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><msub><mrow><mi>m</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> pass through the fixed points <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>,</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> and <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mo>-</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>,</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> respectively. If <math><msub><mrow><mi>m</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi>m</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></math>, then the eccentricity of the locus of the point of intersection of the lines is
questions.solution:
Let, the lines are y=m1x-a and y=m2x+a

which intersects at the point h,k.

⇒k=m1h-a &  k=m2h+a

⇒k2=m1m2h2-a2

⇒k22=h2-a2 (given, m1m2=2)

⇒x21-y22=a2 (Hyperbola)

Eccentricity =1+21=3

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: The sum of the <math><mi>y</mi></math>-intercepts of the tangents drawn from the point <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> to the hyperbola <math><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>-</mo><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></math> is
questions.solution:
Let, the equation of the tangent from -2,-1 is y=mx+3m2-2
⇒-1=-2m+3m2-2
⇒2m-12=3m2-2
⇒m2-4m+3=0
⇒m=1,3
So, the equations of the tangents are
y+1=x+2 & y+1=3x+2
⇒y-intercepts of the tangents are 1 & 5
⇒ the sum of y-intercepts =6

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: The locus of a point which moves such that the difference of its distances from the points <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>5,0</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> and <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>5,0</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> is <math><mn>6</mn></math> units is a conic, whose length of the latus rectum (in units) is equal to
questions.solution:
Because 6<5--5
Hence, the locus is a hyperbola by definition.
Let's assume the eccentricity, semi-transverse axis and the semi-conjugate axis of the hyperbola is e,a, and b respectively, then

2ae=10 {Distance between focii -5,0 & 5,0=10=2ae }
& 2a=6⇒e=106=53
⇒1+b2a2=e2=259⇒b2a2=259-1=169
⇒2b2a=2×169×a=323= length of the latus rectum

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: If the line <math><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi></math> touches the hyperbola <math><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mrow><mn>9</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>-</mo><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mrow><mn>5</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></math> at the point <math><mi>P</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>h</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></mfenced></math>, then <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>h</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> can be equal to
questions.solution:
Tangent at Ph,k is hx9-ky5=1 which is same as y=x+c (where c=±91-5=±2 )
⇒hx9-ky5-1=0 and x-y±2=0 are identical
⇒h91=-k5-1=-1±2
⇒h,k=-92,-52 or 92,52

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: The area (in sq. units) of the triangle formed by the lines <math><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi></math> and the tangent at the point <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><msqrt><mn>5</mn></msqrt><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> on <math><mn>4</mn><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>-</mo><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn></math> is equal to
questions.solution:
Equation of the tangent at point 5,4 on 4x2-y2=4 is 4x5-4y=4⇒5x-y=1.
Now, point of intersection of y=5x-1 & y=2x is 15-2,25-2.
Point of intersection of y=5x-1 and y=-2x is 15+2,-25+2.
Point of intersection of y=2x & y=-2x is 0,0
Now, area of the triangle formed by the points 0,0,15-2,25-2,15+2,-25+2
 =1200115-225-2115+2-25+21=12×1×-2-2=2 sq.units

Similarly, eccentricity of the ellipse x225cos2⁡α+y225=1 is
